name: Ane to Komachi♂ ~Kyonyuu Shimai no Josoukko Ijiri~
original_name: 姉と小町♂ ～巨乳姉妹の女装っ娘いじり～
source:
The boy whose name is Komachi entered in a school where his older sisters go as well.
He starts living with this two naughty sisters and he finds the fact that the school is for girls only!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE056801.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
名叫小町的男孩进入了他姐姐们就读的学校。
他开始和这两个淘气的姐妹住在一起，他发现学校只招收女孩！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE056801.html]DLsite English[/url]]
